entries.title: Why Brittle Solids Crack Under Pressure
entries.summary: Author(s): Ryan Wilkinson Theory and experiments suggest that the mysterious fractures that appear when a brittle material is compressed result from a hidden buildup of internal tension. [Physics 19, 151] Published Fri Nov 06, 2026

entries.title: Two paths, one flux: Trapped ions simulate Aharonov–Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory
entries.summary: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers demonstrated the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a quantum simulation of a lattice gauge theory using a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer.
